answer: Referral work halves every 120 epochs, and the protocol posts every address's work each close. A newcomer counts only if an unrelated established address anchors it with work earned from a non-kin invitee that actually settled: kin earns no cut, one settler backs one head, and the anchor must be whole at the close, so each 120 epochs of age doubles the units it takes. A farm eats the young work first, so its tenth head reaches older work and locks twice what the first locked. The saffron of a fresh anchor fades to jade, and a lotus of clones needs roots it cannot grow.
